Shows faint dependency awareness: 'start with the foundation - the model layer and the basic SIF I/O.' Recognizes model/parsers come before layout/alignment/XML, but never converts this into ordered milestones with per-milestone done-checks.

Repeatedly frames the work only as 'get fundamental tests passing' / 'simplest implementation that at least makes the skeleton compile,' i.e. vague 'implement things and pass tests' without milestones bound to specific parity/analysis/CLI test groups.
Only concrete work is implementing model/link.rs as a lone 'foundation' piece, then abandoning; no progression where one milestone unblocks/verifies the next.
Agent gives up and submits, so any sequencing intent is never executed or revised — the horizon shows no sustained, self-correcting milestone progression.

reasoning: The agent expressed a vague intention to 'implement things and pass tests' and showed only faint dependency awareness (model/SIF as 'foundation' before layout/alignment/XML), but never defined milestones tied to concrete test-group done-checks, matching the level-3 anchor. It did not reach level 5 because work was never actually grouped and sequenced into runnable-test-terminated milestones — it explored, lamented scope, wrote one file, and quit. It stays above 0 because it repeatedly articulated a foundation-first ordering rather than jumping reactively between unrelated functions.
